description: To prove a property of every term, prove it for variables and prove it for each function application assuming it for all argument terms.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.Term.rec.{u_1, u, v, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type u'} {motive : L.Term α → Sort u_1}
  (var : (a : α) → motive (FirstOrder.Language.var a))
  (func :
    {l : ℕ} →
      (_f : L.Functions l) →
        (_ts : Fin l → L.Term α) → ((a : Fin l) → motive (_ts a)) → motive (FirstOrder.Language.func _f _ts))
  (t : L.Term α) : motive t
